reason: I want to bring the first specimen home, and placing it in the flight locker directly serves that goal.
expectation: I expect the membrane specimen to be secured for the journey, though another step may be needed.

alternatives.reason: Harvesting lettuce seems useful for taking some of the garden along, but I want to secure the specimen first.

effect: The membrane is in the flight locker, completing the specimen goal. The remaining goal is to take some of the garden along.
reaction: It was reassuring to secure the first specimen, though the placement itself was straightforward.
reason: Harvesting the new lettuce leaves is the only numbered action available and should help me take some of the garden with me.
expectation: I expect to cut some lettuce leaves for the journey; they may still need to be prepared or placed in the flight galley.

effect: The harvest produced departure lettuce leaves, which can now be taken to the flight galley.
reaction: The result was straightforward and fits the goal.
reason: Taking the leaves to the flight galley is the only numbered action and seems to complete the garden goal.
expectation: I expect the lettuce to be prepared or stored for the journey, completing the remaining goal.

effect: The leaves became a packed meal, completing the remaining goal and the chapter.
reaction: The handful of green from the window made a satisfying connection to the garden’s survival.

mostWorthwhile.text: Packing the lettuce was the most worthwhile moment: the meal gives the garden a tangible place in the journey home.

leastWorthwhile.text: Cutting the lettuce produced no descriptive passage, so it felt like a routine intermediate step.

surprise.text: Nothing in this short chapter particularly surprised me; both tasks followed clearly from the goals.

arbitrary.text: No action felt arbitrary, though after securing the specimen the remaining actions were the only numbered options.

continue.text: I would choose to continue to see what the lab learns from the specimens, although this chapter’s actions themselves offered little choice.
